title: Validate exported formatter output through a runtime node probe
description: Wire the exported formatter so its behavior can be validated by executing the built artifact through a node runtime, covering allowed input, rejected input, and a nearby regression that must not change.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Allowed input is formatted and returned through the runtime node invocation.
AC2: Rejected input is reported as an error through the runtime node invocation.
AC3: Nearby existing formatting behavior is preserved as a regression guard.
AC4: The runtime probe fails with a clear message when the node command is unavailable.
